headline: Troop Movements Escalate Tensions Along Ethiopia-Eritrea Border
summary: Military forces have massed along the 1,000 km Ethiopia-Eritrea border amid territorial disputes over Badme. Security observers warn of potential armed conflict in the Horn of Africa.
why: Conflict in the Horn of Africa threatens regional shipping lanes near the Red Sea and destabilizes East African economies.

impacts.name: Ethiopia
impacts.why: Cross-border conflict risks escalating defense spending and destabilizing macro trade.
